rows.quote:
Furthermore, molecular mechanisms underlying the "sex paradox" of IPAH, where females exhibit higher susceptibility but lower mortality, remain poorly understood, hindering the development of precision therapeutics.

Methods:

We performed an integrated proteogenomic analysis characterizing 2,920 plasma proteins from 45,811 participants in the UK Biobank.
